activity_statements.statement: manufactures ophthalmic surgical devices and systems for cataract, retinal, and refractive surgery sold to ophthalmic surgeons globally
develops and manufactures advanced technology intraocular lenses (ATIOLs) to treat cataracts and correct presbyopia and astigmatism
produces and sells contact lenses (daily disposable, reusable, color-enhancing) and lens care solutions to consumers in 140+ countries
manufactures ocular health consumer products including dry eye treatments (SYSTANE), contact lens care (OPTI-FREE, AOSEPT), and redness relievers
operates in 60 countries and serves patients in more than 140 countries as the world's largest eye care device company
invests substantially in R&D annually to develop next-generation ophthalmic surgical platforms and contact lens technologies

name_reality_gap: The index label 'Medical Equipment Manufacturing' is accurate but incomplete. Alcon is also a major consumer products company through its Vision Care contact lens and eye drop brands sold directly to consumers — part pharma-retail, part surgical-device company.
extraction_notes: About page was comprehensive and well-structured. Clearly describes two-segment model. Segment revenue weights estimated from publicly known split (Surgical slightly larger than Vision Care).
